title: Valid Parentheses
summary: Match every bracket with its partner of the same type, in the correct order.

input.hint: A JSON object with a single string field "s" containing only ()[]

visual.representation: Input characters left-to-right with a growing/shrinking stack column; PUSH, MATCH (pop), MISMATCH and CLOSE_EMPTY frames, plus leftover stack at end.

approach.explanation: Brackets must close in last-opened-first-closed order, which is exactly LIFO, so a stack models the currently open brackets. Push each opener. On a closer, the top of the stack must be its matching opener: if the stack is empty there is no opener left to close, and if the top differs the closer arrived out of order — both are invalid. After scanning everything, the string is valid only when the stack is empty, since any remaining opener was never closed.
